data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m). Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures; a trend which we expect to see continuing. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable. prior_year_events.impact_description: Maturation of the post-recession (from 2012 onwards) portfolio led to increased reserve releases in specialty lines.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded prior-year reserve releases of $180.2m in 2016. The releases were driven largely by favourable claims development and the maturation of the post-recession portfolio (notably from 2012 onwards) which increased releases in specialty lines. These favourable movements were partially offset by lower releases in short-tail classes where reduced margins have mechanically reduced reserve releases.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount (-180.2) was taken from the Managing Agent's narrative statement 'release prior year reserves of $180.2m'. The technical provisions reconciliation shows the overall gross claims provision movement for the year (change in gross claims provision = -23.3) which is a different accounting concept (total change in provision) and not the prior-year release figure; therefore the narrative figure was used as the primary PYD. The narrative does not explicitly label the $180.2m as gross vs net, but context (division breakdown and comparison to net earned premium) indicates it represents gross releases. Reserve triangle and technical notes exist (see page 44) and were inspected; no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross-only line was separately presented, so the narrative was used. Amounts and pages are in USD.
